name: per_area
title: Gauge-normalised weights with the per-area, per-class g_w design
description: Lifted out of make_config_per_area() on 2026-08-21.  Two changes against
the runner default, both derived rather than hand-tuned:
(1) GAUGE NORMALISED -- every member of the exact-scaling group
{g_v, g_q, dso_g_v} u {g_w_*} u {g_z_*} u {shunt_int_g_w} is scaled by the
so g_v = 1/sigma_v_ts^2 and one unit of weighted objective is one TSO
2026-07-31, trajectory reproduced to ~4e-10 including the integer tap
sequence) that a COMMON factor over that group changes nothing: the MIQP
feasible set contains no weight.  The values below are already gauged.
Side benefit and the only legitimate criterion for the gauge itself: the
G_w diagonal moves from [13, 1e9] to [0.05, 4e6], which straddles 1 and is
(2) PER-AREA g_w -- zone_g_w_class / dso_g_w_class carry the per-column
analytic design aggregated per control area.  Needed because one scalar
per area cannot express an area whose classes want to move in opposite
directions: TSO zone 1 wants der well below and tso_oltc well above the

notes: Regenerate after any change to the boundary equivalent, the zone
partition or the start time -- all three change H, and the design is a
function of H.
READ BEFORE RUNNING: the der/pcc numbers are a SUBSTANTIVE re-gain, not
a refinement.  The runner declares BO-tuned precondition_* fields but
sets precondition_g_w = false, so the tuned DER/PCC shape (~57x PCC over
DER) is INERT there.  Writing the design into zone_g_w_class applies
that shape statically, so DER gets ~5-19x more authority and PCC ~7-10x
less than the runner default does.  Regenerate with --tau 1.0 to keep
the analytic shape instead of the BO-tuned one.
The global g_w_<class> scalars are FALLBACKS ONLY here: the per-area
blocks cover every area and class that exists at this operating point.
They carry the same design's global aggregate (geometric mean per class;
max for gen, which is a bound) so a zone added later inherits the
design's regime rather than a value from a different shape.
Three different rules, not one: der/pcc from the curvature rule per
column at lambda_target_tso = 0.5012 and class_scales
{der: 0.13225, pcc: 7.5617} (= tau 0.017484); gen from a per-step move
budget |du| <= 1e-3 pu at a 2 % per-bus reference error (the AVR is
excluded from the curvature rule, so this is its only rule); tso_oltc
from the commit-threshold rule at a 1.5 % systematic offset.
Priorities pi = g*sigma^2 with sigma_v_ts=0.005, sigma_v_ds=0.010,
sigma_q=5.0: pi_v_ts = 1.0 (the unit), pi_q = 25.0 (interface Q priced
25x the TSO voltage unit), pi_v_ds = 0.04 (the DSO voltage schedule,
625x below its own Q).  Change that 625x by moving g_q / dso_g_v, never
by moving the gauge.
